events.title: Murder Mystery at The Cellar: A Haunting 40 Years in the Making
events.description: This murder mystery is going to be one for the books! Forty years ago, a mysterious murder took place in the cellar. The crime was never solved, and the victim's spirit has been haunting the grounds ever since. Now, four decades later, the ghost is ready to reveal the truth. But will you be able to uncover the killer before the night is over? Join us at Christopher Cellars for an immersive evening of mystery, suspense, and a little supernatural activity. Arrive dressed in your Halloween best, enjoy a complimentary glass of wine included with your ticket, and prepare to follow the clues, question the suspects, and uncover secrets buried for 40 years. Throughout the evening, enjoy light bites, specialty drinks available for purchase, and take part in a séance where the spirits may hold the final clue to solving the mystery. Your ticket includes: An interactive murder mystery experience One complimentary glass of Christopher Cellars wine Light bites throughout the evening A séance to help uncover the killer Will the spirit finally find peace, or will the truth remain buried in The Cellar? Costumes are encouraged. Mystery awaits. Get Your Tickets Here!

events.title: Fright Night Halloween Party
events.description: This Halloween, we’re bringing a little mystery, a little magic, and plenty of good wine to Christopher Cellars! Join us for our annual Fright Night Halloween Party, featuring an evening of music, costumes, wine, tarot readings, and Halloween festivities inside our historic winery. Wine & Tarot: Let the Cards Guide You We’re adding something a little mystical to this year’s celebration! Step into the world of ancient wisdom and modern energy with a special Wine & Tarot experience featuring psychic advisor Melody. Throughout the evening, guests will have the opportunity to explore the mysterious world of spiritual readings, including: • Tarot Card Readings: Discover what the cards may reveal about love, relationships, career, and life’s possibilities. • Palm Readings: Explore the ancient tradition of palmistry and the stories believed to be written in the lines of your hands. • Crystal Ball Readings: Experience a little Halloween mysticism through the art of crystal gazing. Whether you’re a believer, simply curious, or looking for something different to experience with friends, this is a fun opportunity to embrace the spirit of Halloween. DJ Torrey Tee | 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM DJ Torrey Tee is bringing the soundtrack to our Halloween celebration! Expect a lively mix of crowd favorites, throwbacks, and dance-worthy hits throughout the evening. Halloween Costume Contest Come dressed in your Halloween best! Whether you’re going spooky, glamorous, creative, or completely outrageous, we’ll be hosting a costume contest with a chance to win. Halloween Wine & Candy Pairing Flight Who says Halloween candy is just for kids? We’re putting a grown-up twist on trick-or-treating with a special Halloween wine flight featuring Christopher Cellars wines paired with classic Halloween candies. Explore how sweetness, acidity, tannins, and fruit characteristics interact with some of your favorite seasonal treats. Specialty Halloween Drinks In addition to our small-lot wines available by the glass and bottle, we’ll be serving festive Halloween-inspired specialty drinks throughout the evening. Food Truck On-Site Come hungry! We’ll have West Coast Taco Bar serving delicious food throughout the celebration.

events.title: R&B Night
events.description: Every Wednesday | 4–8 PM DJ Torrey Tee | 5:30–7:30 PM Make Wednesday nights a little more interesting at Christopher Cellars with R&B Night featuring our resident DJ, Torrey Tee. Join us inside the cellar for an evening of R&B, Hip-Hop, Bay Area classics, and throwbacks, paired with small-lot Christopher Cellars wines and great local food. Our tasting room is open from 4–8 PM , with wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight, along with our signature wine slushies and other seasonal selections. This Week's Food Truck Jerk-N-Juice Jerk-N-Juice brings bold Caribbean-inspired flavors, vibrant spices, and island-style cooking to the table. From savory jerk-seasoned dishes to flavorful sides, their food is a delicious addition to an evening of wine and R&B at Christopher Cellars. Meet DJ Torrey Tee Torrey Tee is a Sacramento-based DJ, creative, and cultural curator known for his ability to read a room and create an atmosphere that brings people together. Blending R&B, Hip-Hop, Bay Area favorites, and familiar throwbacks, Torrey moves effortlessly between laid-back grooves and upbeat selections that keep the energy going throughout the evening. His experience spans Sacramento nightlife, festivals, weddings, corporate events, and community gatherings, including collaborations with Macy's, the City of Sacramento, St. HOPE, Coin-Op, and the R&B Running Series. Beyond music, Torrey is a photographer, filmmaker, and founder of Full Effect Films and Full Effect Entertainment. His creative background brings a thoughtful approach to every performance, making each Wednesday night feel a little different.

We will resume our regular tasting room hours the remainder of the week and look forward to welcoming you back for a weekend of great wine and good company. events.title: Friday Night with BlueSoul Acoustics
events.description: Live Music 4:30–7:30 PM | JJ's Fusion Eats We're taking Friday Night Live Music inside the cellar as the November evenings begin to cool down. With the music a little closer, mulled wine warming on the bar, and the historic barn as our backdrop, we're looking forward to a different kind of Friday at Christopher Cellars. BlueSoul Acoustic joins us from 4:30–7:30 PM, bringing a blend of folk, Americana, indie, and acoustic favorites. Led by Montreal-born musician Terry MacNeill, whose performing career spans more than three decades, BlueSoul draws from artists including Neil Young, Dave Matthews Band, Coldplay, and Oasis. Expect familiar songs, expressive vocals, and the kind of acoustic performance that feels right at home in a smaller setting. JJ's Fusion Eats will be serving their creative, globally inspired menu, including gourmet burgers and chicken sandwiches. At the bar, we'll be pouring our seasonal mulled wine , along with our small-lot wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. Arrive early, find a spot, and enjoy a Friday evening tucked away in the cellar.

events.title: Friday Night with Linden Wood
events.description: Live Music: 4:30–7:30 PM | Local Food Truck We're bringing Friday Night Live Music with mulled wine warming on the bar, live acoustic music filling the cellar, and the character of our historic barn setting the scene. We're looking forward to a more intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Linden Wood Joining us from 4:30–7:30 PM is Linden Wood , a Sacramento-based singer, songwriter, and guitarist whose music blends Americana, alternative country, roots rock, and acoustic storytelling. Performing since his early teenage years, Linden has spent more than a decade building a following throughout Northern California. His musical background stretches from intimate solo acoustic performances to heavier rock and metal, including appearances at the Warped Tour and performances alongside touring acts such as Trivium, Soulfly, Prong, and Floater. As a solo artist, Linden brings a roots-inspired sound, expressive vocals, and a natural connection with his audience. His ability to move between musical styles gives his performances a distinctive character, combining the energy of rock with the warmth and storytelling of Americana. We're excited to welcome Linden into the cellar for an evening where his music can be enjoyed in a more personal setting. Mulled Wine & Seasonal Sips We'll be serving warm, aromatic mulled wine , alongside our collection of small-lot Christopher Cellars wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. A local food truck will also be on-site serving dinner throughout the evening. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. Arrive early to find a spot and enjoy live music in the cellar.

events.title: Wine Club Party
events.description: It's time to celebrate our final Wine Club release of 2026! On Saturday, November 14, Christopher Cellars will be closed to the general public and open exclusively to our Wine Club members and their guests for an afternoon of new releases, seasonal pairings, and a special library wine experience. To register please sign in to your wine club account and click the link below. Register Here Complimentary Wine Tastings & Seasonal Soup Pairings From 12–3:30 PM , the cellar will be open for complimentary tastings of our three featured Q4 Wine Club wines: 2025 Bacchus: A bright, aromatic white wine with fresh fruit character and lively acidity. 2023 Cabernet Sauvignon: A beautifully structured red with rich dark fruit and classic Cabernet character. 2023 Malbec: A bold, full-bodied red featuring dark fruit, spice, and firm tannins. To make this quarter's celebration a little more special, we'll be serving three seasonal soups, each thoughtfully paired with one of our featured Wine Club wines. This enhanced food and wine tasting experience is complimentary for our Wine Club members and their guests. A Special Library Release: Carignan from Mule Plane Vineyard We're also opening something particularly special from the Christopher Cellars library: Carignan from Mule Plane Vineyard. This limited-production wine is a rare opportunity to revisit a special vineyard expression from our cellar. With its depth, character, and food-friendly nature, it's a wonderful wine to bring to the holiday table. Extremely limited quantities will be available for purchase exclusively in the tasting room during this event. Once they're gone, we won't have more to offer. Complimentary Admission | Registration Requested There is no charge to attend, and Wine Club members are welcome to bring guests. Please register in advance so our team can plan accordingly and prepare enough seasonal soup pairings for everyone attending.

events.title: Live Band Karaoke Night with Karaoke Hero
events.description: Forget everything you know about karaoke. This isn't your typical sing-along night. We're welcoming Sacramento-based Karaoke Hero to Christopher Cellars for an evening of live band karaoke, where you don't just sing along to your favorite songs, you become the lead singer of the band. With a catalog of more than 700 songs spanning rock, pop, alternative, punk, metal, and more, Karaoke Hero brings the full concert experience to the stage. Pick your favorite song, grab the microphone, and perform alongside a live band of musicians. Not quite ready to sing? There's another way to join the fun. Karaoke Hero also offers an interactive Guitar Hero-style experience, allowing guests to play along with the band using a Guitar Hero controller. Whether you're taking center stage or enjoying the performances from your seat, it's an evening of live music, good company, and plenty of entertainment. Wine, Music & the Cellar We'll open our doors at 4 PM , giving you time to settle in with a glass of wine before the music begins at 5:30 PM. Our collection of small-lot Christopher Cellars wines will be available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight throughout the evening. The event takes place inside our cellar, creating an intimate setting where guests can enjoy live music, discover new wines, and experience something a little different on a Thursday evening.

events.title: Friday Night with Jon Spivack
events.description: Live Music: 4:30–7:30 PM | Local Food Truck We're bringing Friday Night Live Music indoors with mulled wine warming on the bar, acoustic guitar filling the cellar, and the charm of our historic barn, we're looking forward to a more intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Jon Spivack Joining us from 4:30–7:30 PM is Sacramento guitarist Jon Spivack, a seasoned musician who has been performing throughout the region for more than 25 years. Jon's music moves effortlessly between jazz, folk, blues, and Latin influences, drawing on a diverse repertoire of familiar melodies and timeless classics. His album Branching Out showcases his versatility, from solo jazz guitar to folk and blues duets and Latin-inspired arrangements. Having performed at venues including the Crocker Art Museum, Shady Lady, and several Northern California wineries, Jon brings a thoughtful, expressive approach to the guitar that's particularly suited to the intimate setting of our cellar. Mulled Wine & Seasonal Sips We'll be serving warm, aromatic mulled wine alongside our collection of small-lot Christopher Cellars wines, available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. A local food truck will also be on-site serving dinner throughout the evening. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. Arrive early to find a spot and spend your Friday evening enjoying live guitar, a glass of wine, and the quieter side of the winery.

events.title: Friday Night with Nitewind
events.description: Live Music: 4:30–7:30 PM | Local Food Truck We're bringing Friday Night Live Music indoors with mulled wine warming on the bar, familiar songs filling the cellar, and the character of our historic barn setting the scene, we're looking forward to a lively but intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Nitewind Returning to Christopher Cellars from 4:30–7:30 PM is Nitewind , a Sacramento-based, family-run band known for its impressive musical range and rich vocal harmonies. Founded in 2015, NiteWind features Traci, Michael, and Jared Noche, three accomplished musicians whose backgrounds span international performances, professional recording, and decades of live entertainment. Their repertoire moves between classic rock, jazz, country, pop, and timeless favorites from the 1970s through today. From smooth interpretations of songs by Santana and Nat King Cole to familiar hits by Fleetwood Mac, Journey, and contemporary artists, Nitewind brings a little something for every generation. With multiple vocalists, acoustic guitar, and a natural connection with their audience, Nitewind has become a familiar favorite at Christopher Cellars. Their versatility makes every performance a little different, and we're pleased to welcome them back for an evening inside the cellar. Mulled Wine & Seasonal Sips We'll be serving warm, aromatic mulled wine , alongside our collection of small-lot Christopher Cellars wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. A local food truck will also be on-site serving dinner throughout the evening. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. events.title: Holiday Cookie & Recipe Exchange
events.description: Sunday, December 13, 2026 | 1–3 PM Free to Participate | Advance Registration Required for Cookie Exchange Participants Some of the best holiday traditions begin in the kitchen. A grandmother's handwritten recipe, cookies baked with the kids every December, or a family favorite that always finds its way onto the holiday table. This December, we're bringing those traditions together at Christopher Cellars for Every Cookie Has a Story , a community holiday cookie and recipe exchange celebrating the recipes, memories, and people that make the season special. We invite you to bake a batch of your favorite holiday cookies, share the story behind them, and discover new recipes and traditions from others in our community. Register Here How the Cookie Exchange Works Bake 24 Cookies. Bring 24 Cookies. Take Home 24 Cookies. Register in advance to participate, then bake two dozen of your favorite homemade holiday cookies to bring to Christopher Cellars on Sunday, December 13. When you arrive, we'll collect and arrange everyone's cookies for the exchange. You'll have the opportunity to mingle with fellow bakers, discover different holiday treats, and fill a take-home box with 24 assorted cookies made by other participants. You'll leave with a delicious assortment of holiday cookies and perhaps a few new family favorites. Share the Recipe, Share the Tradition Every cookie has a story, and we'd love to hear yours. Along with your cookies, we encourage you to bring a recipe card featuring the ingredients, baking instructions, and a little note about what makes your recipe special. Is it something your grandmother made every Christmas? A recipe your children request every year? Or a new tradition you've started with your own family? We'll display the recipes as part of our Community Holiday Recipe Exchange , giving guests an opportunity to discover new recipes and take inspiration home for their own holiday baking. Who knows? Your family's favorite cookie might become someone else's new holiday tradition. Wine, Cookies & Community While the cookies are being exchanged, enjoy an afternoon at Christopher Cellars with our collection of small-lot wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. We'll also share a few suggested wine and cookie pairings for those interested in discovering how holiday sweets complement different wines. Bring your family, invite a friend, and spend the afternoon celebrating the simple joy of sharing something homemade.
